headline_marked: Harry Kane wins first Ballon d'Or, becoming England's first winner in 25 years
headline: Harry Kane wins first Ballon d'Or, becoming England's first winner in 25 years
summary: Harry Kane has been crowned the Ballon d'Or winner for 2026, marking a historic moment for English football. Alexia Putellas also claimed the women's prize for a third time.
details: Harry Kane has become the first English player in 25 years to win the Ballon d'Or, receiving the prestigious award in his native London. The 33-year-old Bayern Munich forward beat strong competition from Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe.

Kane's remarkable season saw him score 73 goals in 65 games for club and country, leading Bayern Munich to a league and cup double. He also netted six goals for England in their third-place finish at the World Cup.

Despite a trophy cabinet limited to domestic German titles since his 2023 move to Bayern, Kane's consistent goalscoring has earned him football's highest individual honour. He previously experienced heartbreak in the 2019 Champions League final and twice in the European Championship finals with England.

Alexia Putellas secured her third women's Ballon d'Or, extending Spain's dominance in the award. Her success comes after leading Barcelona to the Champions League title before her move to London City Lionesses, and marks a triumphant return after an ACL injury.

The ceremony in London faced an initial delay due to traffic, with many stars arriving late. However, it concluded with a triumphant moment for the hometown hero, Kane, who described the award as a career highlight.

Young talent Lamine Yamal received an award for young talent for the third consecutive time, though he fell short of becoming the youngest ever Ballon d'Or winner. Kylian Mbappe also continued his wait for the award despite a prolific year.

Other awards included Luis de la Fuente being named men's coach of the year for leading Spain to World Cup glory, and Pere Romeu winning women's coach of the year. Arsenal's Bukayo Saka received the Socrates award for humanitarian work.

headline: 5 killed as lorry rams into people beside Dhaka-Chattogram highway
summary: Three members of the same family were among the dead after a speeding lorry ploughed into passengers standing on the roadside in Sitakunda.
details: At least five people were killed and eight others injured when a speeding lorry ploughed into passengers standing beside the Dhaka–Chittagong highway in Sitakunda early today.
The victims were passengers of a Dhaka-bound bus from Chattogram that had pulled over to the side of the highway due to a mechanical fault.
The accident occurred around 1:10am in the Chhota Kumira Royal Cement Gate area of Sitakunda upazila in Chattogram.
Three members of the same family were among the deceased, including an eight-year-old boy named Rakib.
According to Sitakunda Police Station OC Mohinul Islam, three people died on the spot and two others passed away after being taken to Chattogram Medical College Hospital (CMCH).
The eight injured individuals have been admitted to different wards of CMCH, with several reported to be in critical condition.
caption:
A speeding lorry ploughed into passengers standing on the roadside in Sitakunda, killing 5 and injuring 8.

At least five people were killed and eight others injured when a speeding lorry ploughed into passengers standing beside the Dhaka–Chittagong highway in Sitakunda early today.

The victims were passengers of a Dhaka-bound bus from Chattogram that had pulled over to the side of the highway due to a mechanical fault.

The accident occurred around 1:10am in the Chhota Kumira Royal Cement Gate area of Sitakunda upazila in Chattogram.

Three members of the same family were among the deceased, including an eight-year-old boy named Rakib.

According to Sitakunda Police Station OC Mohinul Islam, three people died on the spot and two others passed away after being taken to Chattogram Medical College Hospital (CMCH).

The eight injured individuals have been admitted to different wards of CMCH, with several reported to be in critical condition.
